name: Miami
tagline: Cold crab since 1913, and the café con leche that Versailles never stops pouring.

Joe's Stone Crab.description: The cold stone crab claws with mustard sauce that have defined Miami since 1913. Open only November through May.

Versailles.description: The heart of Cuban cuisine in Miami, with a ballroom and café con leche flowing around the clock.

Le Jardinier.description: Vegetable-forward French cuisine in the Design District, with a Michelin star in Florida's debut guide.

Ariete.description: Contemporary American technique with Cuban roots from chef Michael Beltran in Coconut Grove. Michelin star.

Los Pinareños Fruteria.description: A family-run fruit stand in Little Havana since 1963, famous for its freshly pressed guarapo (sugarcane juice).
